title: Hows and Whys of Artificial Intelligence for Public Sector Decisions: Explanation and Evaluation
reasoning: The paper discusses the challenges and strategies for explanation and evaluation of AI in public sector decisions. While it touches on accountability (which has ethical implications), it does not have a specific component dedicated to evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics. Its focus is on the technical and practical aspects of building and deploying reliable AI systems.
